mapper.select: SELECT t.id FROM kit_job_registry AS t WHERE t.update_time < DATE_ADD(#{nowTime}, INTERVAL -#{timeout} SECOND)
SELECT t.id FROM kit_job_registry AS t WHERE t.update_time < (#{nowTime} - INTERVAL '1 second' * #{timeout})
SELECT t.id, t.registry_group, t.registry_key, t.registry_value, t.update_time FROM kit_job_registry AS t WHERE t.update_time > DATE_ADD(#{nowTime}, INTERVAL -#{timeout} SECOND)
SELECT t.id, t.registry_group, t.registry_key, t.registry_value, t.update_time FROM kit_job_registry AS t WHERE t.update_time > (#{nowTime} - INTERVAL '1 second' * #{timeout})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kit_job_registry (registry_group, registry_key, registry_value, update_time) VALUES (#{registryGroup}, #{registryKey}, #{registryValue}, #{updateTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE update_time = #{updateTime}

INSERT INTO kit_job_registry (registry_group, registry_key, registry_value, update_time) VALUES (#{registryGroup}, #{registryKey}, #{registryValue}, #{updateTime}) ON CONFLICT (i_g_k_v) DO UPDATE SET update_time = #{updateTime}
